Definition: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot; also his territory and descendants
BiblicalUsage: Moab is the son of Lot by his elder daughter, and the father of a nation that stands against Israel for a thousand years. Balak hires Balaam to curse them, and yet Ruth the Moabitess comes home with Naomi out of the country of Moab, and into the line of David.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Moab is the proof that no nation is written off: the enemy's daughter becomes the great-grandmother of the king.
RelatedEvents: Ruth's Loyalty; Destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah
